_note: New 2026-10-28, built against Zoho_To_CHEDS_ (34).ds. HEDB 202601 removes EIGHT fields on this sheet (Emirates ID, Passport Number, Student Name English, Student Name Arabic, Gender, Student DOB, Nationality, Area of Specialization -- all filled red) and the .ds carries the same note on Student_Internship_Function; none appear here. raw_column values are the dictionary's 'Database Field Name' column verbatim, including the trailing space on Internship_satisfaction. The Zoho form also has an Internship_Duration field that the push sends as internshipDuration, but HEDB 202601 has NO column for it, so nothing is mapped to it and it stays blank on import.

Raw Internship Type code is converted to the exact Zoho picklist text ('IN' -> 'IN-Internship'); the push sends .subString(0,2) to recover the code. NOTE: the Zoho field link name misspells 'Internship' as 'Intership' -- that is the live link name, not a typo here.

Raw code is converted to the exact Zoho picklist text: 'P' -> 'Paid'; 'NP' -> 'Unpaid'. WARNING: the push uses if(rec.Paid_Unpaid == "Unpaid","NP","P"), so a BLANK value silently reports as 'P' (Paid) to the ministry. Make sure this column is never left empty.

No conversion -- this Countries lookup displays [Code], so the raw 2-letter country code is the exact display value and the push sends .Code.
